candidates.violated_requirement: When the input sequence starts with '011' but then has a '1' in the fourth position, the module incorrectly transitions to the failure path instead of continuing the sequence detection. This causes a false not_match output when the full sequence is '011100'.
candidates.spec_basis: The module must detect the sequence '011100' from the input signal 'data'. If the sequence is detected, 'match' should assert; otherwise 'not_match' should assert.
